Below is a short summary of what’s happening, followed by a single *SEARCH/REPLACE* patch that prevents Quarto’s caption‐injection logic from poking a raw `<caption>` into a GT‐generated HTML table (which is what is throwing off the GT spanner grid). By only inserting `<caption>` in non-GT tables we preserve GT’s own CSS and keep the spanner columns aligned.

1.  Bug summary  
    - When you use `gt() %>% tab_spanner()` together with a Quarto `tbl-cap`, Quarto’s Lua filter will see the raw `<table>` coming out of GT, think “ah, I need to inject a `<caption>` here,” and stick one inside the GT table itself.  
    - GT’s grid‐based spanner CSS then measures that extra row and by default stretches the spanner to 100% of the table width, rather than just the two spanned columns.  
    - The fix is to skip Quarto’s raw `<caption>` injection whenever the table is a GT table (detected via `hasGtHtmlTable(raw)`).

2.  Patch  
    - in `src/resources/filters/quarto-pre/table-captions.lua`  
    - locate the HTML‐caption branch in `applyTableCaptions` and change:

```javascript
### src/resources/filters/quarto-pre/table-captions.lua
<<<<<<< SEARCH
        RawBlock = function(raw)
          if idx <= #tblLabels then
            -- (1) if there is no caption at all then populate it from tblCaptions[idx]
            -- (assuming there is one, might not be in case of empty subcaps)
            -- (2) Append the tblLabels[idx] to whatever caption is there
            if hasRawHtmlTable(raw) then
              -- html table patterns
              local tablePattern = htmlTablePattern()
              local captionPattern = htmlTableCaptionPattern()
              -- insert caption if there is none
              local beginCaption, caption = raw.text:match(captionPattern)
              if not beginCaption then
                raw.text = raw.text:gsub(tablePattern, "%1" .. "<caption></caption>" .. "%2%3", 1)
              end
              -- apply table caption and label
              local beginCaption, captionText, endCaption = raw.text:match(captionPattern)
              if #tblCaptions[idx] > 0 then
                captionText = stringEscape(tblCaptions[idx], "html")
              end
              if #tblLabels[idx] > 0 then
                captionText = captionText .. " {#" .. tblLabels[idx] .. "}"
              end
              raw.text = raw.text:gsub(captionPattern, "%1" .. captionText:gsub("%%", "%%%%") .. "%3", 1)
              idx = idx + 1
```
